name: tersign
description: Counter-signed evidence for agent commerce. Verify a counterparty's x402 receipt file, or an evidence bundle with the action records in it, OFFLINE with no account and no API key; record disclosures into a neutral hash-chained ledger anchored to Bitcoin with no configuration (the first call self-provisions a signer-keyed account with a key generated on your machine); issue counter-signed receipts from a seller account you configure in the plugin's settings; fetch a dispute-ready envelope for the venue that will hear it.

seller_key.title: Signing key (optional)
seller_key.description: A 0x-prefixed 32-byte hex private key to sign with, instead of the key the server generates on first use. It never leaves this machine: records are signed locally and only signatures reach the ledger. Leave empty to use the generated key.

ledger_api_key.title: Ledger API key (optional)
ledger_api_key.description: API key of a Tersign seller account. Sent as a bearer token to the ledger URL when issuing counter-signed receipts, recording refunds and filing respondent evidence. Leave empty to verify and record disclosures only.

ledger_seller_id.title: Ledger seller ID (optional)
ledger_seller_id.description: Seller ID of that account. Counter-signed receipts and refunds need it together with the API key and the ledger URL.

ledger_url.title: Ledger URL (optional)
ledger_url.description: Base URL of the ledger, normally https://tersign.ai, entered without a trailing slash (with a trailing slash, receipts and refunds go to //v1/…, which https://tersign.ai answers with 404). Needed for counter-signed receipts, refunds and the dispute tools; when set, disclosures are recorded there too. Leave empty and disclosures go to https://tersign.ai while the receipt-chaining, refund and dispute tools stay off.
